fullDesc: In 2006 Geoffrey Hinton and colleagues published a paper showing how to train deep neural networks layer by layer. It helped revive an idea that had been out of favour for years and set the stage for modern AI.
realFacts: Hinton won the 2018 Turing Award with Bengio and LeCun
He won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2024
He left Google in 2023 to speak about AI risks
